name: NotifyVault
description: Never lose a notification again. NotifyVault silently captures every notification — even after it's dismissed — and stores it permanently. Browse your full notification history, filter by app category, star important ones, set reminders, and search across everything. Supports light and dark themes.

Simple, reliable, and designed for everyday convenience.

name: CipherLink
description: **CipherLink** is a secure and privacy-focused messaging platform designed to provide fast, reliable, and encrypted communication. Built with modern technologies, CipherLink emphasizes user security through end-to-end encryption, ensuring that messages remain accessible only to intended recipients. The platform supports real-time messaging, media sharing, and seamless synchronization while maintaining a clean and intuitive user experience. CipherLink aims to combine strong security practices with ease of use, creating a communication solution that protects user privacy without compromising performance.
